description: Seed a fleet-wide escrow deposit sweep over all escrow-scoped codebases (codebase escrow.enabled). Requires `write` scope. A 10-minute server tick advances it at ≤concurrency deposits in flight. Options: onlyStale (default true — skip fresh deposits), clientTag (one beneficiary only), concurrency (1–5), verifyBuilds (also measure a build+test run per codebase alongside the deposit). Pass {status: true} to just read current sweep progress without seeding.

clientTag.description: Limit to codebases tagged for this client/beneficiary.

onlyStale.description: Default true — only codebases whose deposit is stale.

status.description: true = return current sweep progress, seed nothing.

verifyBuilds.description: Also run a measured build+test verification per codebase (records buildEvidence: duration, toolchains, machine spec).

name: anyforge_start_escrow_sweep
title: Start escrow sweep
